templates.name: Meeting prep
templates.responsibility: Look at my meetings for the next two days. Flag invites I haven't answered, meetings with no agenda, and big meetings where I might not be needed. Check email for anything I should read before each one.
rules: Propose an RSVP for every invite I haven't answered
Draft a short, friendly note asking for an agenda when one is missing

templates.name: Inbox triage
templates.responsibility: Scan unread email from the last day. Separate what needs a reply from me from newsletters and notifications, and sum up the ones that matter in one line each.

templates.name: Focus guard
templates.responsibility: Look at tomorrow between 9:00 and 18:00. If I have less than two free hours in a row, find the best gap and propose a focus block so the day isn't all meetings.
rules: Never propose more than 2 hours of focus time

templates.name: Week ahead
templates.responsibility: Look at the next seven days of meetings alongside recent email about them. Tell me which days are overloaded, which meetings have open questions in email, and where I could win back time.
rules: Point out days with more than 5 hours of meetings
